_schema: Session 44 adverb seeds. Four exercises: de→en (tdist), fill (wrong = words that make the sentence ungrammatical), en→de (de_wrong), sentence meaning (sent_wrong).

fill.de: Wir fahren morgen nach Berlin. Fährst du auch _____?
fill.en: We're going to Berlin tomorrow. Are you going there too?

wrong: I come from there every day.

adverbs.note: Direction towards a place already mentioned (wohin? → dahin). Location is da/dort (wo?), origin is daher/von dort (woher?).

fill.de: Mein Bruder ist _____ groß wie mein Vater.
fill.en: My brother is just as tall as my father.

sentence.de: Sie spricht Spanisch ebenso gut wie Englisch.
sentence.en: She speaks Spanish just as well as English.
wrong: She speaks Spanish better than English.
She speaks neither Spanish nor English.
She speaks Spanish but not English.

adverbs.note: ebenso … wie = just as … as (same as genauso … wie).

sentence.en: My sister is coming along as well.
wrong: Only my sister is coming along.

adverbs.note: Formal 'auch'. Danke, ebenfalls! = Thanks, you too!

fill.en: Although it's raining, we're going for a walk.

sentence.de: Obwohl er müde ist, arbeitet er weiter.
sentence.en: Although he is tired, he keeps working.
wrong: Because he is tired, he stops working.
He is tired, so he goes to bed.
If he is tired, he keeps working.

adverbs.note: Subordinating conjunction: verb goes to the END of the obwohl-clause. Compare trotzdem (main-clause adverb): Es regnet, trotzdem gehen wir.

fill.de: Das Projekt war _____ ein Erfolg, als wir viel gelernt haben.
fill.en: The project was a success insofar as we learned a lot.

adverbs.note: insofern … als = insofar as. Alone: in that respect / to that extent.
